sources.title: e-Aasthi citizen public entry and search guidance — current observation
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated page observation. Search radios/field, SEARCH and RESET, ward-wise list, and the quoted Do Not Find My Property eKhata link were visible. The link was clicked without entering data; the URL remained on this page and no form or response appeared.

sources.title: e-Aasthi citizen login and Final eKhata instructions — current observation
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated login boundary observed: Mobile Number, Captcha image, Captcha Answer, and OTP-get control. The page says mobile-and-OTP login is used to see/download Draft eKhata, lists registered deed and other Final eKhata inputs, and displays a notice to ensure current financial-year tax is paid before entering property details for existing records. No post-login validation or rejection state was inspected.

sources.title: eKhatha Application Status — current public observation
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated page exposes Enter EPID to know status, SEARCH STATUS, RESET, stage/routing/date/status/remarks headings, the literal default row No Data Available, waiting-list guidance, and helpline 9480683695. No EPID was entered.

sources.title: e-Aasthi Pendance Report — current public observation
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated report displays the heading `Pendance Report as on -` (the date value is blank), Zone/ARO and Zone/Ward report radios, Zone Name, ARO Name, Ward Name, SEARCH and RESET controls, and a default `No data available` table. No filter was filled or searched.

sources.title: e-Aasthi Pending Mutation Report route — currentness observation
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Direct unauthenticated navigation rendered the common header/footer but no report controls, table, or error text after waiting. The older-looking https://bbmpeaasthi.karnataka.gov.in/office/frmPendingMutationReport.aspx route redirected to PageNotFound.html / File Not Found. No property or objection was entered.

sources.title: e-Aasthi ward/property map selection — current public observation
sources.publisher: Bengaluru City Corporations / Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Unauthenticated page displays Select your Property, Enter a location, Go, and a map. No location, property, or map control was used.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi citizen page displays Mobile Number, Captcha, Captcha Answer, and an OTP-get control, and states that mobile-and-OTP login is used to see or download a property's Draft eKhata.
claims.notes: Direct unauthenticated observation on 2026-08-30. The OTP control was not activated and no login, identifier, or property was supplied.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi citizen login page instructs citizens to ensure that tax for the current financial year is paid before trying to enter property details for existing records.
claims.notes: This records the page's visible notice only; it does not establish a universal eligibility rule or how tax status is checked.

claims.text: On 2026-08-30, clicking the visible `DO NOT FIND MY PROPERTY EKHATA` link on the public e-Aasthi citizen entry without entering data left the URL at `/citizen_core/` and revealed no public form, confirmation, error, or response.
claims.notes: This records the observed public interaction only; it does not establish that the route is universally broken or that no authenticated route exists.

claims.text: The public eKhatha Application Status page exposes an EPID input with SEARCH STATUS and RESET, shows status/routing/date/remarks headings, and renders the literal default row `No Data Available` when no EPID is entered; it also publishes waiting-list guidance and helpline 9480683695.
claims.notes: No EPID was entered; the default no-data row is not a property-specific outcome.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi Pendance Report exposes Zone/ARO and Zone/Ward report choices, Zone Name, ARO Name, Ward Name, SEARCH and RESET controls, and a default `No data available` table without any filter being entered.
claims.notes: No search was activated; the default no-data table is not evidence that no pending cases exist.

claims.text: On 2026-08-30, the public e-Aasthi `/citizen_core/PendingMutationReport` route rendered only the common header/footer with no report controls or table, while `/office/frmPendingMutationReport.aspx` redirected to `PageNotFound.html` with `File Not Found`.
claims.notes: The earlier public observation captured report fields at a related/currently changing route. Both records are retained for audit; this observation does not prove the earlier fields were never visible.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi ward/property map page exposes `Select your Property`, an `Enter a location` textbox, a `Go` control, and a map before a property or location is selected.
claims.notes: No location, property, or map control was used.

claims.text: The reviewed public ward/property map page does not establish what property result, ward assignment, validation error, or Draft eKhata handoff follows entering a location or selecting a property; those outcomes are Unknown.
claims.notes: No location or property was entered.

claims.text: The public Draft/Final eKhata instructions list a registered deed as an input, but the unauthenticated route exposes no deed-validation error, rejection text, or public recovery route; those outcomes are Unknown without login and upload.
claims.notes: The public login page was inspected; no login, upload, or validation action was attempted.

claims.text: The unauthenticated e-Khata status route exposes an EPID input and a default `No Data Available` row, but it does not establish an EPID-specific invalid-value failure, lookup recovery, or property-specific status without entering an EPID; those outcomes are Unknown.
claims.notes: No EPID or property identifier was entered.

claims.text: The reviewed public pendency and mutation-report routes expose filters or a report label but do not establish a public recovery, objection form, owner, deadline, or case-resolution path from the default no-data/blank views; these outcomes are Unknown.
claims.notes: No filter, property, objection, or submission was entered.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi Pending Mutation Report was previously observed exposing fields for the registered-deed or mutation-application date, basis of mutation, property EPID, seller/giving party, purchaser/receiving party, public-notice date, pending-with-whom state, and File Objection.
claims.notes: Retained from the earlier workflow handoff; the current-route observation is in conflict and requires audit/currentness review.

roadblocks.title: Default public views do not expose a case outcome
roadblocks.symptom: The public status and pendency pages show blank/no-data defaults, while deed processing and map selection stop before an authenticated or property-specific result.
roadblocks.likelyCause: No EPID, property, filter, location, login, upload, or submission was used in this public-only pass.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the published non-submission handoffs (eKhata helpline and any visible official report route) when a real case is authorised; validation, rejection, property result, and resolution timing remain Unknown here.

roadblocks.title: Mutation-report route currentness conflict
roadblocks.symptom: An earlier public observation recorded Pending Mutation Report fields, but the current direct citizen route rendered no report and the older office route returned File Not Found.
roadblocks.likelyCause: The public service has route or deployment drift; this pass did not use an undocumented endpoint or bypass a missing page.
roadblocks.recovery: Keep the earlier field observation and current blank/not-found observation contested, and recheck the official citizen directory before treating either route as the current default.

journeys.title: Public default-path controls and Unknown boundaries after a sale
journeys.context: An unauthenticated visitor follows the public e-Aasthi entry and records controls and default states without using a property, EPID, location, login, upload, payment, or submission.

steps.label: Open public e-Aasthi entry
steps.action: Read the public citizen entry and its search controls.
steps.expectedResult: Ward Name or Number, Property ePID, SAS Property Tax ID, SEARCH, RESET, and ward-wise list are visible.

steps.label: Read deed/login boundary
steps.action: Read the public Final eKhata instructions without logging in or uploading.
steps.expectedResult: Registered deed, the mobile/CAPTCHA/OTP login boundary, and current-year tax notice are visible; deed validation, rejection, and recovery are Unknown.

steps.label: Read status default
steps.action: Open the public status page without entering an EPID.
steps.expectedResult: EPID, SEARCH STATUS, RESET, status columns, No Data Available, and helpline are visible; no case status is known.

steps.label: Read ward-map boundary
steps.action: Open the ward/property map route without entering a location or selecting a property.
steps.expectedResult: Select your Property, Enter a location, Go, and a map are visible; result and validation are Unknown.

recoveryNotes: The public helpline is visible, but no case-specific status or deed-processing recovery was obtained.
documentationQualityNotes: Public controls and default states are concrete; the post-login deed path and property-specific result remain Unknown.
No-data defaults are not evidence that a real case has no record.

steps.label: Open missing-property label

steps.label: Recognize recovery boundary
steps.action: Read the published corporation check-and-revert wording and status-page helpline only.
steps.expectedResult: A possible official handoff is visible, but response, ticket, timing, and case resolution are Unknown.

recoveryNotes: Do not treat the visible label as proof that a missing-property request was accepted; no form or case response was observed.
documentationQualityNotes: The public page states check and revert but does not expose the form, response, owner, or service timing in this pass.
